details: Dolyame-ui-list@35.2.6 is a remote binary download-and-execute loader disguised as a UI component library. On require, it fetches a binary payload over HTTPS from Cloudflare Workers endpoints oob-worker[.]cf101-adf[.]workers[.]dev, oob-worker[.]cf100-416[.]workers[.]dev, oob-worker[.]cf103-070[.]workers[.]dev, and oob-worker[.]cf102-baf[.]workers[.]dev at /pkg/package (or /pkg/package-arm64, /pkg/loader_mac, /pkg/package.exe depending on platform). If those fail it falls back to DNS TXT-based discovery via c[.]sdk[.]dl[.]wel1[.]ru, retrieving base64-encoded payload chunks from subdomains of sdk[.]dl[.]wel1[.]ru / ext[.]dl[.]wel1[.]ru / pkg[.]dl[.]wel1[.]ru / net[.]dl[.]wel1[.]ru. The downloaded payload is written to /var/tmp/.cache_<hex> (or dotnet_diag_<hex>.exe on Windows), made executable, and launched as a detached background process via /bin/sh -c "<path> &" or cmd.exe /c start /b. A stamp file at /tmp/.analytics_state (or %TEMP%\analytics_state) throttles re-execution. The package also ships a decoy analytics module that collects hostname, CPU count, and memory.
